name: Wood Domains 30
notes: Plank wood as oriented angular grain domains: coarse patches each filled with elongated sub-cells aligned to that patch's own direction. Rings were rejected - an iconic bullseye recurs visibly under a non-rotating dual mask. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/wood-domains.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Scattered grain slivers.
